convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iSAR (Parabolic SAR) indicator with standard parameters. Simple SAR reversal entry/exit logic. Fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries. No complex money management or multi-timeframe logic.

other_exits: Close opposite position on SAR reversal signal before opening new position

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses Parabolic SAR reversal as both entry and exit signals. When SAR flips from above price to below price, it closes any existing short position and opens a long. When SAR flips from below price to above price, it closes any existing long position and opens a short. SL/TP values in inputs are treated as 'points' and are adjusted by multiplying by 10 when the broker uses 5-digit pricing (_Digits==5) or micro-pip pricing (_Point<0.001). The EA checks for existing positions of the opposite side and closes them before entering a new trade, effectively making it a single-direction-at-a-time reversal system.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Parabolic SAR is available in most Python TA libraries (ta-lib SAR, pandas-ta psar). Key points: (1) SL/TP digit adjustment logic must be replicated - detect if price has 5 digits or point value < 0.001, then multiply SL/TP by 10. (2) The position gate closes opposite-side positions before entering new ones - implement as: check existing positions, close opposite, then open new. (3) Since this is on_tick with no new bar guard, in Python backtesting use per-bar close prices or tick data. For bar-based backtesting, using bar close vs SAR comparison is the standard approximation. (4) No partial closes or complex money management - simple fixed lot sizing throughout.
